construction_definition_repairs.name: ofCoeffs
construction_definition_repairs.reason: In the old Mathlib representation AddMonoidAlgebra was a Finsupp type alias; the new representation is a structure with a coeff Finsupp field. The original v.toFinsupp data is unchanged.
construction_definition_repairs.preserved_witness: coeff_ofCoeffs is still proved by rfl: every coefficient equals v.getD i 0.

construction_definition_repairs.name: rationalize
construction_definition_repairs.reason: The same ascending coefficient list, integer-to-rational map and toFinsupp value are retained.
construction_definition_repairs.preserved_witness: rationalize_eq_map and rationalize_natDegree are unchanged mathematical statements with unchanged proof bodies.

proof_repairs: FastSearch: unfold baseIndexQ explicitly when simplifying an existing specification.
Intervals: explicit algebraMap_int_eq and Rat.coe_castHom simplifications.
MaxExists: setOfPred_minimal_antichain replaces the deprecated alias; upstream confirms identical proposition.
PrefixEnumeration: bitIndices_sum_map_two_pow has exactly the same sorted-list binary expansion proposition as the old theorem name.
PrefixInterval: explicit next_last and replacement of conditional simplification names; all caps and interval definitions are unchanged.
preserved_construction: prefixAt is bitIndices mapped by Nat.succ; prefixAt 0 is the empty prefix; prefixCode and its surjectivity are unchanged.
Polynomial boxes, lexicographic coefficient vectors, degree/height filters, concatenation order, leastHeight Nat.find and polyAt indexing are unchanged.
The rational least denominator remains max(M+1, floor((c-q)^(-1))+1), including strict integer-boundary handling.
crossingTimeQ remains the first successful Nat.find; recorded capsFoldQ starts from b and folds the same skipped-step predecessor caps.
badIndexQ remains the least successful index; the two-candidate fast routine and its equality theorem are unchanged.
The finite nonroot grid and leastGood Nat.find are unchanged.
The same four-way rational radius and narrowQ endpoints are retained.
The initial interval is [1/4,1/3]; stage n+1 refines stage n using prefixAt n, polynomial P n and radius index n+1.
Main.explicitReal remains the unique nested-interval limit for polyAtQ; approximation remains the stage-n midpoint. No replacement by an unspecified existential counterexample was introduced.

challenge_interface.quantifiers: Existential positive StrictMono infinite sequence and arbitrary n0, all n >= n0 including n0=0, strict feasibility and all same-length positive Pairwise(<) competing lists, with <= allowing tied maxima.
challenge_interface.main_correspondence: The ordinary predicate corresponds exactly to DenominatorChain and BestUnder. Solution constructs that chain from the list predicate; Main also proves the attained-Rn formulation using Rn_attained and bestUnder_iff_sum_eq_Rn.
challenge_interface.challenge_holes: Two definition-value interfaces and one theorem proof placeholder. These are not proofs. Solution fills both values with the actual original construction and proves the theorem.
